architecture_decisions: {Restore exact repository credentials for production deployment}
work_items: {Production deployment of P2-V0.23.34 with exact repository credentials}
validations: {Verify that `production_provider_preflight.py` requests exact repository credentials and that derived credentials see only the registered repository}

AC-01: validate protected requirement — The workstream records both failed exact-source redeploy identities and the precise fail-closed installation-wide token mismatch without claiming an outage, successful redeploy, or W9-S1 completion.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Tests prove `production_provider_preflight.py` sends the exact registered repository and only `contents:read` plus `metadata:read` in Vercel Connect `authorizationDetails` before GitHub reads.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Tests prove a returned credential seeing two repositories, zero repositories, or the wrong repository fails before numeric repository, branch, tree, or Blob verification.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Tests prove projected-source Connect exchange uses the same exact read-scoped request and independently rejects broad/mismatched derived credentials before branch/tree/content reads.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Tests prove `verify_registered_runtime_github_credentials()` requests each registered repository separately with read-only authorization details and accepts only an independently verified exact-one-repository credential.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Deterministic provider fixtures model an installation covering multiple repositories while returning an exact scoped token per request. Provider preflight, projected-source preflight, and readiness succeed only for the requested target; no credential can read or mutate another covered repository.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — The exact delivery-permission preflight continues to request only `contents:write`, `metadata:read`, and `pull_requests:write` for one registered repository, with no repository administration, merge, production promotion, domain, environment-variable, or deletion permission.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Focused and full regressions prove numeric repository identity, source path/tree/file/byte bounds, private Blob verification, OIDC validation, secret exclusion, fail-closed provider classification, and no secret persistence remain unchanged.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — After exact-head gates and expected-head merge, the corrected API source reaches production READY with all provider, delivery-permission, projected-source, Blob, lineage, runtime, snapshot, and schema preflights green; `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 and exact-deployment warning/error/fatal scans are clean.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The protected Decision Ledger replay against the still-empty approved `Ryan9876/parallax-qa1` repository resumes after production verification. It must not recur as installation-wide scope failure, missing Vercel readiness credential, or repository-authorization failure. It advances to REVIEW or records any genuinely later bounded blocker separately.
risks: {Preserve existing provider boundaries and ensure compatibility with multiple repositories}
